The affix ङीप् is added, in forming the feminine to the stems that end in the syllable वन् , and र् is the substitute of the final such syllable.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

The living descendant of a grandson etc. is called optionally a युवन् when a more superior सपिण्ड other than a brother is alive.

Terms: युवन्

The affix कप्‌ does not come after a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in the word भ्रातृ when it means 'praised'.

Terms: कप्‌

The substitution of अव् and आव् for ओ and औ also takes place before an affix beginning with य।

Terms: संहितायाम्

After a preposition वन has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in compounds of every kind.

Terms:

For the final vowel of कोटर etc. a long vowel is substituted before वन and also of किंशुलक etc. before गिरि when the compound is a name.

Terms: संहिता changes
For the final आ of any other root than those mentioned in घुमास्थागापाजहातिसां हलि

, ए may optionally be substituted in the Benedictive active, when the root begins with a conjunct consonant.

Terms: अभीय Rules

The न of वन , is changed into ण , when preceded by the words पुरगा , मिश्रका , सिध्रका , शारिका , कोटरा and अग्रे , as first members of the compound, and the whole compound is a name.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-समास
